# compact synthetic full-ish run with memory measurement
import random,time,resource,sys
random.seed(11)
C=4; patterns={c:[] for c in range(C)}
for c in range(C):
 seen=set()
 while len(patterns[c])<512:
  a=random.randrange(0,3029);b=random.randrange(0,3029)
  if a==1514 or b==1514 or (a,b) in seen:continue
  seen.add((a,b));patterns[c].append((a,b))
disc=[]
for c in range(C):
 seqs=[]
 for p in patterns[c]:seqs += [p,p]
 for r in range(64):
  vals=[0]*128;act=[0]*128
  for q in range(16):
   p=seqs[r*16+q];pos=q*8;vals[pos]=p[0];vals[pos+1]=p[1];act[pos]=act[pos+1]=20
  disc.append({'class':c,'values':vals,'activation':act})
train=[]
for i in range(8192):
 c=i%C;a=random.randrange(0,3029);b=random.randrange(0,3029)
 if a==1514:a=1513
 if b==1514:b=1513
 train.append({'class':c,'values':[a,b]})
val=[]
for i in range(8192):
 c=i%C
 vals=[random.randrange(0,3029) for _ in range(120)]
 vals=[1513 if x==1514 else x for x in vals]
 val.append({'class':c,'values':vals})
# total values 32768+16384+983040=1032192
rel={'id':'m','classes':C,'width':2,'eps':[0,1],'ratio':[0,1],'threshold':[1,1],'mode':'exact','packet_limit':100000,'idle_us':10**12,'discovery':disc,'train':train,'validation':val}
ops=[['install','m']]
for i in range(1000):ops += [['open',f'f{i}'],['packet',f'f{i}',i,0,100],['packet',f'f{i}',i+1,1,100],['close',f'f{i}']]
req={'capacity':{'range':8,'exact':4096},'releases':[rel],'blocks':[ops]}
t=time.time()
import pipeline
ans=pipeline.execute(req)
print('time',time.time()-t,'rss_kb',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'entries',ans['catalog'][0]['entries'],'frags',len(ans['catalog'][0]['fragments']),'clusters',len(ans['catalog'][0]['clusters']),'decisions',len(ans['decisions']))
